_comment: GoWild! pass rules. SEED values - run `sync` and see README for verification. Blackout dates change every program year.

bookingWindow.domesticNote: Domestic GoWild fares become bookable the day before departure (Eastern time).

typicalCostPerSegmentUSD.notes: You pay taxes/fees only (base fare $0.01). Connections cost more (per-segment fees).

connectionRules: GoWild bookings may include Frontier connections on one itinerary; availability is per-flight and capacity controlled.
feesNotes: Bags and seat assignments are NOT included - pay at booking or bring a free personal item only.

searchLinks.notes: Log in to flyfrontier.com with the GoWild pass on your account, then search; GoWild fares appear as a fare option when available for eligible flights.
